## Scope

This report documents deterministic recovery of the PN1–PN8 K-means model.
Only the original nine-patient Pilot was used. K was fixed at eight and no
21-patient projection, RCTD, NMF, edgeR, GSEA, ligand–receptor, or Marker
analysis was run.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd

working = Path.cwd()
recovery = working.parent if working.name == "report" else working / "results/reanalysis/REFERENCE18_SPATIAL_GRAPH_NEIGHBORHOODS_V1/PILOT_MODEL_RECOVERY"
if not (recovery / "01_MODEL_PROVENANCE.tsv").exists():
    raise RuntimeError(f"Recovery directory not found from {working}")

provenance = pd.read_csv(recovery / "01_MODEL_PROVENANCE.tsv", sep="\t")
parameters = pd.read_csv(recovery / "02_RECOVERED_MODEL_PARAMETERS.tsv", sep="\t")
reproducibility = pd.read_csv(recovery / "03_PILOT_LABEL_REPRODUCIBILITY.tsv", sep="\t")
confusion = pd.read_csv(recovery / "04_PN_CONFUSION_MATRIX.tsv", sep="\t")
metadata = json.loads((recovery / "models/MODEL_METADATA.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
```

```{python}
pd.DataFrame(

            metadata["training_bin_n"],
        ],
    }

```

The model is called `MODEL_RECOVERED_EXACT` only because all 50,972 evaluable
Pilot bins reproduced their original PN labels without label permutation or
post-hoc remapping.

## Provenance checks

```{python}
provenance
```

No pre-existing serialized fitted model was found in the authoritative Pilot
result tree. The final script, frozen inputs, graph, transformation, sampling,
K=8, and seed 20261025 were therefore replayed once. The recovered graph edge
set and standardized feature matrix matched the final implementation exactly.

## Frozen deployment artifacts

```{python}
parameters.groupby("parameter_type", as_index=False).size()
```

The deployment bundle contains the 8 × 18 standardized cluster centers, the
18-dimensional feature scale, the Reference18 order, the cluster-to-PN map,
and the ordered 21,165-bin balanced training set. New-patient centering is
defined from that patient's unlabeled Hellinger-transformed ego composition;
new PN labels are not used for centering.
